content: Just looking at these Fire Elemetal ingots, you instincively feel like throwing them at someone would somehow deal more damage compared to any other elemetal ingots.
Weapon it is, and what better weapon to deal damage with than a good old sword.
While hammering the ingot into a sword, the energy from the strikes got absorbed into the blade until at one point the sword struck back.
I'm going to need to be careful with this material it looks like...
The Fire Elemetal Sword stores the impact of your strikes inside of the material, Each consecutive hit lights one of the gems set into the blade.
This energy is unstable and disappears quickly, do not expect it to stick around when you put the sword down.
Wildly swinging the sword is also not advised as you are just discarding the stored energy immediately.
Once all three gems are lit, the next strike releases this stored energy and deals twice as much damage. This attack cannot crit nor sweep.
